decisions.reason: Critical PostgreSQL RCE vulnerability CVE-2026-6471 (PostGREShell) with 12-year history, allows privilege escalation to superuser and persistent backdoors. Substantive security event.

CVE-2026-6471.evidence: Article describes PostGREShell as actively exploitable by low-privileged replication accounts for code execution and persistent backdoor installation.

decisions.reason: Novel attack methodology: AI agents used for full enterprise breach chain including credential harvesting and cloud infrastructure hijack. Important threat landscape evolution.
Data breach with competitive intelligence angle: 3,100 customer leads stolen and sold to rival. Specific numbers and pricing details available.
